{"code":"import json,numpy as np
from sklearn.gaussian_process import GaussianProcessRegressor
from sklearn.gaussian_process.kernels import Matern,ConstantKernel
from scipy.optimize import differential_evolution
D=json.load(open('evaluations.json')); names=[r['ingredient'] for r in D[1]['recipe']]; print(names)
X=np.array([[{a['ingredient']:a['fraction'] for a in d['recipe']}.get(n,0) for n in names] for d in D]); y=np.array([d['target_dissimilarity'] for d in D]);
# exclude substitutions
keep=[i for i,d in enumerate(D) if all(a['ingredient'] in names for a in d['recipe'])]; X=X[keep];y=y[keep]
scale=np.array([.1,.04,.05,.03,.03,.001,.001,.003,.001]);gp=GaussianProcessRegressor(kernel=ConstantKernel(.03,(.001,1))*Matern(1,(.2,5),nu=2.5),alpha=1e-7,normalize_y=True,n_restarts_optimizer=6).fit(X/scale,y)
bounds=[(.13,.185),(.055,.125),(.065,.10),(.03,.065),(.0005,.0025),(.0005,.0025),(.002,.006),(.0003,.0018)]
def ac(z):
 x=np.r_[1-sum(z),z];m,s=gp.predict([x/scale],return_std=True);return float(m[0]-.9*s[0])
r=differential_evolution(ac,bounds,seed=1,popsize=15,maxiter=160); xx=np.r_[1-sum(r.x),r.x]; print(gp.kernel_);print(list(zip(names,xx)));print(gp.predict([xx/scale],return_std=True));json.dump({'names':names,'x':xx.tolist()},open('candidate.json','w'))"}
